hooks: Microsoft released a patch fixing almost 1,100 Windows vulnerabilities.
The update patches flaws that could let attackers take over your PC.
Microsoft says the patch fixes 1,093 vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws.
what_happened: Microsoft released updates that fix 1,093 security bugs in Windows, covering 63 critical flaws that could let attackers control a system.
why_it_matters: It reduces the chance of attackers seizing control of Windows PCs and elevates overall system security.
what_to_do: Back up important data before installing the updates.
